blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police seized 1,710 reams of suspected illegally traded cigarettes worth P1.615 million in separate operations in Bataraza and Narra, Palawan, on Oct. 30 and 31. Three individuals, including a minor, were apprehended, the Palawan Police Provincial Office (PalPPO) reported. During the first operation in Bataraza, a 30-year-old fisherman identified only as alias “Sam” allegedly sold 50 reams of Fort Menthol cigarettes for P14,000 to a police poseur-buyer around 10 p.m. on Friday in Sitio Tagdalongon, Barangay Rio Tuba. The suspect managed to escape after recognizing the operating team and fleeing toward a dark area. Police recovered […]...
